measured.what: Which kinds of edit install in place
measured.unit: edit kinds, plus sampled agent commits
measured.method: 1,437 agent-written Megatron commits were classified by a script as: no code change, installable by a function swap, or needing a restart. 34 commits were then drawn evenly from the restart group and installed into one running process, each followed by a correctness check.
measured.caveat: This is an earlier build of the lab for Megatron, which re-imports changed files. It is not the lab in repos/megatron on main: that one swaps function bodies and refuses constructors, new fields and module-level changes (3 of 6 real upstream PRs were refused). 34 of 34 is not a property of the public repo's Megatron lab.

measured.what: Which mechanism a real performance PR needs
measured.method: 487 performance PRs found (2026-07-24 to 2026-10-24); 80 sampled and inspected by hand (63/80 = 79% install in place in this repo, 8/80 = 10% C++/CUDA native edits demonstrated only in a pre-repo prototype, 9/80 = 11% restart). A classification of what each PR would need, not a test that each installs.
